title: MagicMod
description: Add useful crystals and cool wands!
body:
## This mod require FabricAPI to work!

**Make battles more spectacular by using the added crystals and staves!**

Mana ore will generate underground, and you can use it to craft various wands and crystals. A total of 17 new items, blocks, and wands will be added. Crystals provide effects such as buffs and increased mobility. For example,You can fly sky by the crystal.Also you can make wands from crystals,They are themed around each crystal.

～Each Crystal's Effects～

  
- Mana Crystal: Grants Durability
- Enhanced Mana Crystal: Grants Regeneration and Greater Durability
- Exploding Mana Crystal: Explodes when used (twice the power of TNT)
- Wind Crystal: Allows movement through the air, can also be used for landing
- Wild Crystal: Reduces movement speed but grants significantly stronger regeneration, durability, and other effects

～About each staff～
- Mana Staff: Hold down to shoot water, gains durability.
- Enhanced Mana Staff: Strikes down lightning to weaken surrounding enemies, gains greater durability, etc.
- Explosive Mana Staff: Shoots TNT that explodes upon impact (low durability).
- Breeze Staff: Has two modes, switchable with Shift + Right Click. Knocks back opponents when used. Can also be used on yourself (deals damage).
- Earth Mana Staff: Left Click to drop rocks. Right Click on the ground to create a 2x3 wall (disappears after 10 seconds).

※Additionally, a wand with no cooldown has been added, although this is limited to Creative mode.

<details>
<summary>Japanese</summary>
動かすにはFabricAPIが必要です！
  
Geminiによって作られたModです。マナ鉱石から得られるマナクリスタルを使って様々なアイテムや杖を作ることができます。
それぞれのクリスタルの効果は
  
- マナクリスタル：使うと5秒耐久がつきます。
- 強化マナクリスタル：上のやつよりすごい
- 膨張しそうなマナクリスタル：危ない
- ウィンドクリスタル：使うと楽しい
- ワイルドクリスタル：移動速度低下するけど強化マナクリスタルより強い

杖について
それぞれのクリスタルを使って杖を作れます。
- マナの杖：使うと耐久、水が撃てる(射程20)
- 強化マナの杖：雷降らせる(射程えぐい)
- 爆裂の杖：TNT飛ばす、耐久10
- ブリーズ杖：2つのモードがあり、Shift+右クリックで切り替えれる。使うと飛ぶ
- 大地の杖：左クリックで石降らして、右で2X3の壁作る

※クールダウンのない杖がクリエイティブ限定であります。

ちなみにマナの杖と強化マナ杖はシャベルとしても使えます。

</details>


![Some of the additions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/974ee8d7204869051e655e267b7fed0946102477_0.webp)

This mod`s code made by Gemini.
But I created the textures and gave the instructions.


**Due to insufficient testing, errors will occur in versions of Minecraft other than 1.21 and 1.21.1.
In addition, item descriptions will be in Japanese.**
